# Yo Mama Jokes Central

> Yo Mama Jokes Central (https://www.yomamajokescentral.com) is a free website
> featuring hundreds of Yo Mama jokes organized into 21 themed categories,
> plus a hand-picked set of 5 featured jokes refreshed daily. A "Yo Mama joke"
> is a short insult-comedy one-liner that humorously exaggerates a trait of
> someone's mother.

## Main pages

- [Home — Featured jokes of the day](https://www.yomamajokescentral.com/)
- [All joke categories](https://www.yomamajokescentral.com/categories)
